conditions: The package version is exactly v1.9.0.
This is a fix-version claim: the described X-Forwarded-Prefix input-validation issue affects versions before v1.9.0, and is not present starting with this version.
summary: gin-gonic/gin before v1.9.0 is vulnerable to improper input validation via the X-Forwarded-Prefix header: redirectTrailingSlash used the header's value unsanitized to build the redirect path, so a specially crafted value like ../../api could produce an open-redirect-style path traversal, potentially leading to cache poisoning (GHSA-3vp4-m3rf-835h). Fixed in v1.9.0 by sanitizing the header value with regSafePrefix ([^a-zA-Z0-9/-]+) before using it to build the redirected path.
